title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
taper: From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen

ai_review.summary: Top‑curated audience tape that captures the first live Ripple and Truckin' with an ecstatic crowd, delivering a high‑quality listening experience.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this recording five stars, highlighting its status as the best curated version of the show on the Archive and praising the historic first live performances of Ripple and Truckin'. The audience source is praised for its clarity and atmosphere, with no reported sound issues, making it a go‑to listening pick for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star reviews focusing on both the musical significance (first live Ripple/Truckin') and the quality of the curated tape indicate an excellent show and a solid recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Curated version praised as the best available; no complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs, indicating clear audience capture despite typical ambient noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic crowd energy with historic first live renditions of Ripple and Truckin', fitting smoothly between the acoustic and electric sets.
